environment.description: EKS pod running the same container image on Amazon Linux 2023 worker nodes. The node-level containerd runtime has a custom AppArmor profile 'k8s-order-consumer' loaded and enforced via the pod annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/order-consumer=localhost/k8s-order-consumer. The profile specifies: deny /etc/** w, deny /var/spool/** w, deny /tmp/** w, allow /var/log/orders/** w, deny /var/log/orders/../** w, and includes path normalization with 'attach_disconnected' flag. Additionally, the pod securityContext sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with an emptyDir volume mounted only at /var/log/orders. The combination means even if CRLF injection crafts malicious log content, the path traversal component (writing outside /var/log/orders/) is blocked by the AppArmor deny rules which normalize paths before evaluation, and the read-only root filesystem prevents any writes outside explicitly mounted volumes.
